source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Αυξέντιος ο εν Λαοδικεία Φρυγίας μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is none of the corpus's other men of the name — of Bithynia, of Cyprus, of Kartilio, of Vella, the companion of Eustratius — none of whom is a martyr of Laodicea in Phrygia and none of whom is kept on 28 July. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence: what the page says is only that it has nothing, «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Αγίου Μάρτυρα», which is a statement about the record and not a doubt about the entry. No year, no manner of death and no hymn, so no `dates` object; Laodicea of Phrygia is named in the line itself and `locations` is left out.
